other_conditions: Minimum land holding 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and maximum 10 acres (4 ha)

Beneficiaries selected on a first‑come, first‑served basis

benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy up to ₹15,000 per hectare for seed spice cultivation and access to certified high‑quality seeds.
